headline: B200 index eases -3% to $8.25 while every other tracked GPU holds flat over 7 days.
bullets: B200 is the only mover, with its market index down -3% to $8.25 across 9 providers, and RunPod Community Cloud lowest at $5.98.
H200, H100 SXM, MI300X, A100 80GB SXM and L40S all show +0% 7-day change, at indexes of $5.40, $4.32, $4.73, $2.70 and $1.50.
H100 SXM carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +162%, with a hyperscaler median of $10.68 against a neocloud median of $4.07 and Vast.ai at $2.00.
MI300X leads on price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, just ahead of B200 at $3.67, though only 4 providers list it.
A100 80GB SXM is the costliest per unit of compute at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour despite a $2.70 index, and Vast.ai offers it at $1.22.
watch: Watch whether B200's -3% slide continues and narrows its +77% hyperscaler premium, the smallest of any tracked GPU.
